component.name: Parquet Explorer
component.summary: Official Parquet Explorer — view and edit Parquet files

description.p: Official Parquet Explorer by Nanda Kumar Matha. This is the authoritative desktop app for opening, browsing, editing, filtering, and visualizing Apache Parquet files.
Install only the official package named parquet-explorer. Unofficial forks or lookalike listings are not affiliated with this project.
